title: Your Love Sickness
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A boys' love anthology. In the title story, two fox spirits guarding an Inari shrine, the serious low-ranked red fox Unka and the reckless high-born white fox Aura, are childhood friends and lovers divided by rank. Other stories follow a lost man seduced by a forest spirit, an injured model and the bento-shop manager who visits him, and a police officer reunited with a yakuza childhood friend.
life_message: Love can bridge rank and difference when both partners are honest and bold.

content.note: Yakuza character in final story; no violence described (ANN review).
Several 'steamy' sexual encounters and nudity among adult characters (ANN review); MangaDex erotica; consensual per review.
MU lists Dubious Consent, but ANN says consent is consistent throughout (to verify).
